name: Concert-AAP CVE Remediation Handler
description: Triggers Ansible Automation Platform to orchestrate CVE remediation via Lightwell and Gitea CI/CD

blocks.name: Extract CVE Context
blocks.code:
cve_data = {
    'cve_id': input_data.get('cve_id'),
    'severity': input_data.get('severity', 'unknown'),
    'cvss_score': input_data.get('cvss_score', 0),
    'affected_dependency': input_data.get('affected_packages', [])[0] if input_data.get('affected_packages') else '',
    'affected_application': input_data.get('affected_applications', [])[0] if input_data.get('affected_applications') else '',
    'ibm_risk_score': input_data.get('ibm_risk_score', 0),
    'fix_available': input_data.get('fix_available', False)
}
output = cve_data

blocks.name: Determine Lab ID
blocks.code:
application_name = cve_data['affected_application']
if '-lab-' in application_name:
    lab_id = application_name.split('-lab-')[1].split('-')[0]
else:
    lab_id = 'unknown'
cve_data['lab_id'] = f'lab-{lab_id}'
output = cve_data

blocks.name: Log Success
blocks.message: AAP workflow triggered successfully for CVE ${cve_data.cve_id} in lab ${cve_data.lab_id}
